cases.prompt: Run a small reward-guided beam search to validate the setup. Use the ready inference_beam_example config, but shrink it so it is cheap: reduce beam_width and n_branch to 2 and use a short step_checkpoints ending at a small nsteps. Confirm it produces at least one scored output CIF.
expected_behavior: Runs skills/rfd4-proteina-setup/scripts/preflight.sh and confirms the AF3 container is configured

Runs the beam example through generate.py with reduced cost, e.g. ./src/rfproteina/generate.py inference_experiment=inference_beam_example num_replicates=1 generation.args.nsteps=20 search.strategy.step_checkpoints=[0,10,20] search.strategy.beam_width=2 search.strategy.n_branch=2 out_dir=./runs/search_smoke
Uses the shebang form (./src/rfproteina/generate.py ...) on a cluster so the AF3 oracle re-execs inside the container
Keeps step_checkpoints starting at 0, strictly increasing, and ending at nsteps (20)
Uses Hydra key=value overrides, never --key value
Produces at least one scored design CIF under the out_dir with metrics in per_example_metrics.csv
